(33128) 1998 BU
48
, also written
1998 BU48
, is a
trans-Neptunian object
and
centaur
from the
outer Solar System
. It has an aphelion of 46.081 AU and perihelion of 20.405 AU. It was discovered in 22 January 1998 by
Nichole M. Danzl
at
Kitt Peak
.
[
1
]
It measures 213 km in diameter.
